checklist.ipc_hidumper_args_protocol: IDumpBroker::Request args mirror the CLI SetCmdArgs (argv0 + '-p <pid> --thread' + trailing pid); verified on device to yield the 'Thread num / Top names' summary, not a bare ps -efT dump
checklist.ipc_sa_load_on_demand: hidumper SA acquired via CheckSystemAbility then blocking LoadSystemAbility fallback; null-checked at every step, degrades to a note instead of crashing
checklist.permission_kill_app: KillApplication only invoked for a backgrounded app with a non-empty bundleName (foregroundKnown && !foreground && !bundleName.empty); AppMgrClient enforces its own ams permission; native (non-app) processes are never killed
checklist.fd_lifecycle: every open() checked <0; close(fd) on all paths; temp dump files removed via FileUtil::RemoveFile after read (hidumper + stacktrace temp fds)
checklist.dir_readdir_closedir_paired: opendir null-checked, closedir on every return path in GetAllProcessPids / GetThreadRunStates
checklist.concurrency: trackMap_ and seq_ guarded by mutex_ (HandleProcess/CleanupDeadProcesses hold std::lock_guard); ffrt poll loop joined in OnUnload via ffrt::wait before teardown
checklist.no_unbounded_growth: one-shot fault dedup (faultReported) + CleanupDeadProcesses purge of exited pids; verified on device: exactly 1 conclusion over 4+ scan cycles
checklist.log_bounds: each collected section capped (MAX_DUMP_SIZE 512KB, merge cap 1MB, file reads capped) to keep logs bounded
checklist.privacy: conclusion holds pid/uid/process+bundle name/thread maintenance/stacks, written under protected /data/log/reliability/resource_leak/thread_leak (dir mode 0770, file default 0660); no cross-user data
checklist.resource_leak_self_review: pthread/attr destroyed; no leaked fds; temp files unlinked
checklist.hisysevent_yaml_declared: RELIABILITY:THREAD_LEAK event declared in hisysevent.yaml with matching params (PID/UID/PROCESS_NAME/PACKAGE_NAME/THREAD_COUNT/FOREGROUND/MSG)
checklist.build_cfi: ohos_source_set enables full cfi sanitize (cfi/cfi_cross_dso/cfi_vcall_icall_only, debug=false) as required for hiview targets

changes_applied_during_review: hidumper args fixed to append trailing pid so --thread summary is produced (was ps -efT)
stacktrace switched from DumpStacktraceJsonFast (JSON) to DumpStacktrace (human-readable text)
added real-threshold ThreadLeakDetectorModuleTest (external child victim, staged warning->fault) + committed sample conclusion log
CFI sanitize block + missing std headers (<cstdlib>/<cerrno>/<map>) added
verdict: zero issues; ready for upload review
